pilot.text: A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 71 new patients and 64 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 1 of them (0 to 3) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 18.5% to 20.5% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count.

gap.overall: Four of five checks say the gap is real. Stage at diagnosis is the one public data cannot answer; the records audit (8 weeks, €8,000) settles it.
